function EnemyHelper:Create(enemyId:number,parent:Instance)
    local enemyLo = EnemyHelper:GetLo(enemyId)
    if not enemyLo then return end

    local enemy:Model
    if enemyLo.isMounted then
        enemy = EnemyHelper:CreateMountedEnemyV2(enemyId,parent)
    elseif enemyLo.isAnimal then
        enemy = EnemyHelper:CreateAnimal(enemyId,parent)
    else
        enemy = EnemyHelper:CreateEnemy(enemyId,parent)
    end
    return enemy
end

function EnemyHelper:CreateEnemy(id:number,parent:Instance,isRevive:boolean?)
    local prefab = EnemyHelper:GetPrefab(id)
    if not prefab then return end

    local lo = EnemyHelper:GetLo(id)
    local enemy:Model = prefab:Clone()
    enemy.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Atomic
    local humanoid:Humanoid = enemy:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")

    ValueHelper:InitByModel(enemy,EnemyValue)
    ValueHelper:InitByModel(enemy,NpcAttributeValue)
    ValueHelper:SetValue(enemy,EnemyValue.id,id)
    -- ValueHelper:SetValue(enemy,EnemyValue.atkDamage)
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(enemy,EnemyValue.atkDamage,"基础",(lo.atkDamage or 0) * EnemyHelper:GetGameEnemyDamageRateValue().Value)
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(enemy,EnemyValue.hungerDamage,"基础",(lo.hungerDamage or 0))
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(enemy,NpcAttributeValue.walkSpeed,"基础移速",lo.speed)
    if lo.reviveTimes and lo.reviveTimes > 0 then
        if not isRevive then
            -- 初始化复活次数
            ValueHelper:SetValue(enemy,EnemyValue.reviveTimes,lo.reviveTimes)
        end

        humanoid.Died:Once(function()
            -- 因为关系到重复创建，这里有重复创建的大部分参数，所以把复活逻辑放在这里
            local reviveTimes = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(enemy,EnemyValue.reviveTimes)
            if reviveTimes > 0 then
                enemy.Parent = workspace -- 确保在工作区内才能创建特效

                reviveTimes -= 1
                Debris:AddItem(enemy,5)

                task.wait(1)
                local humanoidRootPart:Part = enemy:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                humanoidRootPart.Anchored = true

                TweenService:Create(humanoidRootPart,TweenInfo.new(1),{
                    CFrame = humanoidRootPart.CFrame + Vector3.new(0,2.5,0)
                }):Play()

                -- 创建复活特效
                local fire:Attachment = EffectHelper:CreateWorkspaceEffect("僵尸复活")
                fire.CFrame = CFrame.new()
                fire.Parent = humanoidRootPart

                task.wait(2) -- 等待3秒后复活
                local pos = enemy:GetPivot().Position

                -- 创建新敌人
                local reviveEnemy = EnemyHelper:CreateEnemy(id,parent,true)
                reviveEnemy:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pos))
                ValueHelper:SetValue(reviveEnemy,EnemyValue.reviveTimes,reviveTimes)

                -- 把复活火焰，设置到新的敌人身上
                local reviveHumanoidRootPart:Part = reviveEnemy:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                fire.Parent = reviveHumanoidRootPart
                EffectHelper:AddItem(fire,1)
                
                -- 移除旧敌人
                enemy.Parent = nil
            end
        end)
    end

    humanoid.DisplayName = lo.name
    humanoid.WalkSpeed = lo.speed
    humanoid.MaxHealth = lo.hp * EnemyHelper:GetGameEnemyHPRateValue().Value
    humanoid.Health = humanoid.MaxHealth


    if parent then
        enemy.Parent = parent
    end

    enemy:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Enemy)
    enemy:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Bandit) -- 强盗
    enemy:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.StreamingObject)
    if lo.isDestroyer then
        enemy:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Destroyer)
    end
    if lo.isGhost then
        enemy:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Ghost)
    end
    if lo.isZombie then
        enemy:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Zombie)
    end
    return enemy
end

-- 是否有阻挡
function EnemyHelper:IsModelObstructionByCollsionGroup(origin:Model,target:Model)
	local originRootPart:Part = origin:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local targetRootPart:Part = target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
	raycastParams:AddToFilter({origin,target})
	raycastParams:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Enemy))
	raycastParams:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Horse))
	raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	raycastParams.CollisionGroup = GameEnum.CollisionGroup.Environment

	local offset = (targetRootPart.Position - originRootPart.Position)
	local hitResult:RaycastResult = workspace:Raycast(originRootPart.Position,offset.Unit*offset.Magnitude,raycastParams)
	return hitResult ~= nil
end

-- 是否有阻挡
function EnemyHelper:IsInAttackRange(origin:Model,target:Model,ranged:number)
	local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
	overlapParams:AddToFilter(target)
	overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

	local hits = workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(origin:GetPivot(),Vector3.one * ranged,overlapParams)
	return #hits > 0
end

-- Mounted enemies are authored as complete prefabs. The cloned root is the rider
-- and the horse is already attached through MountedEnemyMotor.
function EnemyHelper:CreateMountedEnemyV2(id:number,parent:Instance)
    local lo = EnemyHelper:GetLo(id)
    if not lo then return end

    local prefab = EnemyHelper:GetPrefab(id)
    if not prefab then
        warn("[EnemyHelper] mounted prefab missing:", id, lo.name)
        return
    end

    local enemy = prefab:Clone()
    enemy.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Atomic

    local riderHumanoid = enemy:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    local riderRoot = enemy:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or enemy.PrimaryPart
    local horse = enemy:FindFirstChild("MountedHorse")
    local horseHumanoid = horse and horse:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    local horseRoot = horse and (horse:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or horse.PrimaryPart)
    local motor = enemy:FindFirstChild("MountedEnemyMotor", true)
    if not riderHumanoid or not riderRoot or not horse or not horseHumanoid or not horseRoot or not motor then
        enemy:Destroy()
        warn("[EnemyHelper] invalid mounted prefab:", lo.name)
        return
    end

    ValueHelper:InitByModel(enemy,EnemyValue)
    ValueHelper:InitByModel(enemy,NpcAttributeValue)
    ValueHelper:SetValue(enemy,EnemyValue.id,id)
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(enemy,EnemyValue.atkDamage,"基础",(lo.atkDamage or 0) * EnemyHelper:GetGameEnemyDamageRateValue().Value)
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(enemy,EnemyValue.hungerDamage,"基础",(lo.hungerDamage or 0))
    ValueHelper:SetBonusValueValue(enemy,NpcAttributeValue.walkSpeed,"基础移速",lo.speed)

    riderHumanoid.DisplayName = lo.name
    riderHumanoid.MaxHealth = lo.hp * EnemyHelper:GetGameEnemyHPRateValue().Value
    riderHumanoid.Health = riderHumanoid.MaxHealth
    riderHumanoid.WalkSpeed = 0
    riderHumanoid.AutoRotate = false
    -- Keep the rider-to-horse Motor6D intact while the shared EnemyDeathService
    -- fades and destroys the complete mounted root model.
    riderHumanoid.BreakJointsOnDeath = false
    pcall(function()
        riderHumanoid.EvaluateStateMachine = false
    end)

    for _, descendant in ipairs(enemy:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant:IsA("BaseScript") then
            descendant.Enabled = false
        elseif descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
            descendant.Anchored = false
        end
    end

    for _, descendant in ipairs(enemy:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant:IsA("BasePart") and descendant:IsDescendantOf(horse) then
            descendant.Massless = false
        elseif descendant:IsA("BasePart") and not descendant:IsDescendantOf(horse) then
            descendant.CanCollide = false
            descendant.CanTouch = false
            descendant.Massless = true
        end
    end

    enemy.PrimaryPart = riderRoot
    if parent then
        enemy.Parent = parent
    else
        enemy.Parent = workspace
    end

    local seat = horse:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Seat",true)
    if seat then
        seat.Disabled = true
        seat.CanTouch = false
    end
    horse:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.Horse)
    horse:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.MountedHorse)

    enemy:RemoveTag(GameEnum.Tag.Bandit)
    enemy:SetAttribute("MountedEnemyId",id)
    enemy:SetAttribute("MountedStyle",lo.attackType == "Gun" and "Gunslinger" or "Lancer")
    enemy:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.MountedEnemy)
    enemy:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Enemy)
    enemy:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.StreamingObject)

    for _, descendant in ipairs(enemy:GetDescendants()) do
        if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
            pcall(function()
                descendant:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
            end)
        end
    end

    return enemy
end

function EffectHelper:PlayWorldPrefabsPartEffect(name:string, parent:BasePart, lifeTime:number)
	local prefab = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("Effects"):WaitForChild(name)
	local effect:Part = prefab:Clone()

	if parent:IsA("Model") then
		local model:Model = parent
		parent = model.PrimaryPart
	end
	effect.CFrame = parent.CFrame
	effect.Parent = parent

	local weld = CommonFunc:WeldConstraint(parent,effect)
	weld.Parent = effect

	if lifeTime and lifeTime > 0 then
		EffectHelper:AddItem(effect,lifeTime)
	end
	return effect
end

function EffectHelper:PlayAnchoredWorldEffect(name:string, position:Vector3, parent:Instance,lifeTime:number)
	local prefab = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("Effects"):WaitForChild(name)
	local effect:Part = prefab:Clone()
	effect.Anchored = true
	effect.CanCollide = false
	effect.CanQuery = false
	effect.CanTouch = false
	effect.CastShadow = false
	if position then
		effect:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position))
	end

	if not parent then
		parent = workspace
	end
	effect.Parent = parent

	if lifeTime and lifeTime > 0 then
		EffectHelper:AddItem(effect,lifeTime)
	end

	return effect
end

function EffectHelper:AddItem(effect:Instance,lifeTime:number,fadeOut:boolean)
	if not lifeTime then
		lifeTime = 0
	end

	task.delay(lifeTime,function()
		if not effect:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return end
		
		CommonFunc:ForDescendant(effect,function(child:ParticleEmitter)
			if child:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or child:IsA("Fire") or child:IsA("Smoke") then
				child.Enabled = false
			end
		end)

		if fadeOut then
			CommonFunc:ForDescendant(effect,function(child:BasePart)
				if child:IsA("BasePart") then
					TweenService:Create(child,TweenInfo.new(1),{
						Transparency = 1
					}):Play()
				end
			end,true)
		end
	end)
	Debris:AddItem(effect, lifeTime+5)
end

function EffectHelper:PlayHalo(name,rootPart:Part,lifeTime,isSole:boolean)
	if isSole == nil then
		isSole = true
	end

	local character:Model = CommonFunc:GetCharacter(rootPart)
	local humanoidRootPart:Part = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	
	local position = humanoidRootPart.Position
	if isSole then
		local characterHeight = character:GetExtentsSize().Y
		position += Vector3.new(0,-characterHeight * 0.5,0)
	end
	local halo:Part
	if type(name) == "string" then
		halo = EffectHelper:PlayEffect(name,position,humanoidRootPart,nil)
	else
		halo = name
	end
	halo.Transparency = 1
	halo.Anchored = false
	halo.CanCollide = false
	halo.CanQuery = false
	halo.CanTouch = false
	halo.CastShadow = false

	local weldConstraint:WeldConstraint = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	weldConstraint.Part0 = humanoidRootPart
	weldConstraint.Part1 = halo
	weldConstraint.Parent = halo
	
	if lifeTime and lifeTime > 0 then
		EffectHelper:AddItem(halo,lifeTime)
	end
	
	return halo
end

function EffectHelper:PlayWeldConstraintEffect(name,rootPart:BasePart,lifeTime,offset:Vector3)

	if offset then
		position += offset
	end
	local effect:Part
	if type(name) == "string" then
		effect = EffectHelper:PlayEffect(name,position,rootPart,nil)
	else
		effect = name
	end
	effect.Transparency = 1
	effect.Anchored = false
	effect.CanCollide = false
	effect.CanQuery = false
	effect.CanTouch = false
	effect.CastShadow = false

	local weldConstraint:WeldConstraint = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	weldConstraint.Part0 = rootPart
	weldConstraint.Part1 = effect
	weldConstraint.Parent = effect
	
	if lifeTime and lifeTime > 0 then
		EffectHelper:AddItem(effect,lifeTime)
	end
	
	return effect
end

function EffectHelper:PlayWorkspaceEffect(name:string,position:Vector3,parent:Instance,lifeTime:number)
	local effectPrefab:Part = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("Effects"):WaitForChild(name)
	local effect = effectPrefab:Clone()
	if position then
		if effect:IsA("Model") then
			local primaryPart = effect.PrimaryPart
			if primaryPart then
				effect:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(CFrame.new(position))
			else
				effect:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position))
			end
		else
			effect.Position = position
		end
	end
	if effect:IsA("Attachment") then
		if position then
			effect.CFrame = CFrame.new(position)
		else
			effect.CFrame = CFrame.new()
		end
	end
	effect.Parent = parent or workspace

	CommonFunc:ForDescendant(effect,function(child:ParticleEmitter)
		if child:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			child.Enabled = true
		end
	end)

	if lifeTime and lifeTime > 0 then
		EffectHelper:AddItem(effect,lifeTime)
	end

	return effect
end

function EffectHelper:CreateWorkspaceEffect(name:string)
	local effectPrefab:Part = _effectFolder:WaitForChild(name)
	if not effectPrefab then 
		warn("Effect prefab not found:", name)
		return nil
	end
	local effect = effectPrefab:Clone()
	return effect
end

function EffectHelper:CreateKillMonsterGem(monster:Model)
	if not monster then return end

	local torso = monster:FindFirstChild("Torso") or monster:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or monster:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local cframe = torso.CFrame
	local gem:Part = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("Items"):WaitForChild("Gem"):Clone()
	gem.CFrame = cframe + Vector3.new(math.random(-2,2),0,math.random(-2,2))
	gem.Parent = workspace

	local r = 5
	local forceXZ = 20
	local forceY = 100
    local dir = Vector3.new(math.random(-r,r),0,math.random(-r,r)).Unit
    gem.AssemblyLinearVelocity = dir * forceXZ + Vector3.new(0,math.random(forceY * 0.5,forceY),0)

	task.delay(1,function()
		gem.Anchored = true
		local lifeTime = 0.5
		Debris:AddItem(gem,lifeTime)
		local t = 0
		local startPosition = gem.Position
		local character = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
		while gem and gem:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and character and character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) do
			local dt = task.wait()
			t += dt
			if t > lifeTime then
				t = lifeTime
			end

			local endPosition = character:GetPivot().Position
			local position = startPosition:Lerp(endPosition,math.clamp(t / lifeTime,0,1))
			gem.Position = position
		end
	end)
end

function EffectHelper:PlaySmash(pos:Vector3,num:number?,force:number?,prefab:BasePart?)
	-- local force = 50
    if not force then force = 50 end

	local lifeTime = 3
	local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(lifeTime * 0.5,Enum.EasingStyle.Linear,Enum.EasingDirection.Out,0,false,lifeTime * 0.5)
    if not num then num = 20 end
	for i = 1,num do
		local part:BasePart
		if prefab then
			part = prefab:Clone()
		else
			part = _effectFolder:WaitForChild("碎片"):Clone()
		end
		part.Anchored = false
		part:AddTag("Debris")

		local offset = Vector3.new(math.random(-5,5),math.random(-5,5),math.random(-5,5))
		part.Size = part.Size * (1 + math.random() * 2)
		part.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + offset)
		part.Parent = workspace

		local force3 = Vector3.new(math.random(-force,force),force,math.random(-force,force)) 
		part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = force3
		part.AssemblyAngularVelocity = force3.Unit * 20

		local tween = game.TweenService:Create(part,tweenInfo,{
			Transparency = 1,
		})
		tween:Play()
		game.Debris:AddItem(part,lifeTime)
	end
end

return EffectHelper

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local CommonFunc = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("framework"):WaitForChild("CommonFunc"))

local ValueHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ValueHelper"))

local CampfireSetting = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("ExcelConfig"):WaitForChild("CampfireSetting"))

local CampfireValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.CampfireValue
local CraftingBenchValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.CraftingBenchValue

local GroundValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.GroundValue
local BuildingValue = ValueHelper.ValueModel.BuildingValue

local MapHelper = {}

MapHelper.onMapInitComplete = CommonFunc:InitBindableEvent(script,"onMapInitComplete")

MapHelper.gridSize_1 = game.ReplicatedStorage.DefaultSetting:FindFirstChild("格子大小1").Value::number
MapHelper.gridSize_2 = game.ReplicatedStorage.DefaultSetting:FindFirstChild("格子大小2").Value::number
-- MapHelper.mapSize_1 = game.ReplicatedStorage.DefaultSetting:FindFirstChild("地图大小").Value::number
-- MapHelper.mapSize_2 = MapHelper.mapSize_1 / MapHelper.gridSize_2

MapHelper.GridInfoEnable = game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("DebugSetting"):WaitForChild("显示网格信息").Value::boolean

MapHelper.mapSize_1 = MapHelper.mapSize_2 * MapHelper.gridSize_2
MapHelper.mapSize = MapHelper.mapSize_2 * MapHelper.gridSize_2 * MapHelper.gridSize_1
MapHelper.centerGrid1 = math.ceil(MapHelper.mapSize_1 / 2)
MapHelper.centerGrid2 = math.ceil(MapHelper.mapSize_2 / 2)

MapHelper.halfGridSize_1 = MapHelper.gridSize_1 / 2
MapHelper.halfGridSize_2 = MapHelper.gridSize_2 / 2
MapHelper.startX = -MapHelper.mapSize_1 / 2 * MapHelper.gridSize_1 + MapHelper.halfGridSize_1
MapHelper.startZ = -MapHelper.mapSize_1 / 2 * MapHelper.gridSize_1 + MapHelper.halfGridSize_1


MapHelper.GridType = {
    campfireLand = 1,-- 营地
    building = 2,-- 建筑物
    Stronghold = 3,-- 神枪手据点
    GemTower = 4,-- 宝石塔
    Hospital = 5,-- 医院
    MiniStronghold = 6,-- 小据点
    LightHouse = 7,-- 灯房子
    Special = 8,-- 特殊地块
    Marsh = 9, -- 沼泽
    MarshPond = 10, -- 沼泽
    ToxicSwamp = 11, -- 有毒沼泽
    Railway = 12, -- 铁路
    Snowfield = 13, -- 雪原
    SnowfieldPond = 14, -- 雪原池塘
    land = 101,-- 地块
    pond = 102,-- 池塘
}

MapHelper.CaveY = {
    WildBoarCave = -150, -- 野猪王洞穴
    Train = -200, -- 火车
    BellCave1 = -230, -- 1级铃铛洞穴
    BellCave2 = -270, -- 2级铃铛洞穴
    BullCave = -100, -- 牛牛副本
}

MapHelper.ZoneMap2 = {}::{{GameType.GridVo}} -- Grid2等级划分映射
MapHelper.ZoneMap1 = {}::{{GameType.GridVo}} -- Grid1等级划分映射
MapHelper.EnterGroundMarks = {}::{boolean}
MapHelper.isInit = false

local _map:{{number}} = {}
local _resPointSizeMap:{Vector2} = {}

math.randomseed(tick())
function MapHelper:init()
    for grid2X = 1,MapHelper.mapSize_2 do
        for grid2Z = 1,MapHelper.mapSize_2 do
            local level = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid2Pos(grid2X,grid2Z)
            if not MapHelper.ZoneMap2[level] then
                MapHelper.ZoneMap2[level] = {}
            end
            local gridVo:GameType.GridVo = {
                x = grid2X,
                z = grid2Z
            }
            table.insert(MapHelper.ZoneMap2[level],gridVo)
        end
    end

    for grid1X = 1,MapHelper.mapSize_1 do
        for grid1Z = 1,MapHelper.mapSize_1 do
            local level = MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid1(grid1X,grid1Z)
            if not MapHelper.ZoneMap1[level] then
                MapHelper.ZoneMap1[level] = {}
            end
            local gridVo:GameType.GridVo = {
                x = grid1X,
                z = grid1Z
            }
            table.insert(MapHelper.ZoneMap1[level],gridVo)
        end
    end
end

function MapHelper:GetMapGridType(grid1X:number,grid1Z:number)
    if not _map[grid1X] then
        return
    end
    return _map[grid1X][grid1Z]
end

function MapHelper:GetIsSafetyRange(centerGrid1X:number,centerGrid1Z:number,r:number)
    local centerGridType = MapHelper:GetMapGridType(centerGrid1X,centerGrid1Z)
    if centerGridType then return end

    for offsetX =-r,r do
        for offsetZ=-r, r do
            local grid1X = offsetX + centerGrid1X
            local grid1Z = offsetZ + centerGrid1Z
            local gridType = MapHelper:GetMapGridType(grid1X,grid1Z)
            if gridType then return end
        end
    end

    return true
end

function MapHelper:GetMapGridTypeByGround(ground:Part)
    local gridVo:Vector3 = ValueHelper:FindValueValue(ground,GroundValue.grid)
    return MapHelper:GetMapGridType(gridVo.X,gridVo.Z)
end

function MapHelper:SetMapGridType(grid1X:number,grid1Z:number,mapType:number)
    if not _map[grid1X] then
        _map[grid1X] = {}
    end
    _map[grid1X][grid1Z] = mapType
end

function MapHelper:GetCampfireLo(level:number)
    local lo:CampfireSetting.Type = ConfigHelper:GetById(CampfireSetting,level)
    return lo
end

function MapHelper:GetGridPos(grid1X:number,grid1Z:number)
    local posX = MapHelper.startX + (grid1X-1) * MapHelper.gridSize_1
    local posZ = MapHelper.startZ + (grid1Z-1) * MapHelper.gridSize_1
    return posX,posZ
end

function MapHelper:GetGridPos3(grid1X:number,grid1Z:number)
    local posX,posZ = MapHelper:GetGridPos(grid1X,grid1Z)
    return Vector3.new(posX,0,posZ)
end

function MapHelper:MapScaleToWorldPos(scaleX:number,scaleZ:number,y:number?)
    local worldX = math.clamp(scaleX,0,1) * MapHelper.mapSize - MapHelper.mapSize / 2
    local worldZ = math.clamp(scaleZ,0,1) * MapHelper.mapSize - MapHelper.mapSize / 2
    return Vector3.new(worldX,y or 0,worldZ)
end

function MapHelper:Pos2Grid1(position:Vector3)
    local mapX = position.X - (MapHelper.startX - MapHelper.halfGridSize_1)
    local mapZ = position.Z - (MapHelper.startZ - MapHelper.halfGridSize_1)
    local grid1X = math.ceil(mapX / MapHelper.gridSize_1)
    local grid1Z = math.ceil(mapZ / MapHelper.gridSize_1)
    return grid1X,grid1Z
end

function MapHelper:GetMapParent()
    local mapParent:Folder
    if RunService:IsServer() then
        mapParent = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
        if not mapParent then
            mapParent = Instance.new("Folder")
            mapParent.Name = "Map"
            mapParent.Parent = workspace
        end
    else
        mapParent = workspace:WaitForChild("Map")
    end
    return mapParent
end

function MapHelper:GetGroundPart(grid1X:number,grid1Z:number)
    local groundName = string.format("%d,%d",grid1X,grid1Z)
    local ground:Part = MapHelper:GetMapParent():WaitForChild(groundName)
    return ground
end

function MapHelper:GetLandingPoint(position:Vector3)
    local ground = MapHelper:GetGroundPart(MapHelper:Pos2Grid1(position))
    if not ground then return end
    local groundPos = ground.Position
    local ret = Vector3.new(position.X,groundPos.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2,position.Z)
    return ret
end

-- 安全着陆点
function MapHelper:GetSafeLandingPoint(position:Vector3)
    local point = MapHelper:GetLandingPoint(position)
    local hitResult:RaycastResult = workspace:Raycast(point + Vector3.yAxis * 100,Vector3.yAxis * -200)
    if hitResult then
        return hitResult.Position + Vector3.new(0,1,0)
    end

function MapHelper:GetGroundPoint(position:Vector3)
    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    raycastParams:AddToFilter(CollectionService:GetTagged(GameEnum.Tag.Player))
    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    raycastParams.CollisionGroup = GameEnum.CollisionGroup.OnlyGround
    local hitResult:RaycastResult = workspace:Raycast(position + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), Vector3.new(0, -20, 0), raycastParams)
    if hitResult then
        -- if hitResult.Instance:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.Ground) then
        --     return hitResult.Position

        return hitResult.Position
    end
    return nil -- 没有着陆点

        -- print(hitResult.Instance.Name)

function MapHelper:RandomGrid1Point(grid2X:number,grid2Z:number)

    local gird1XMin = (grid2X - 1) * MapHelper.gridSize_2 + 1
    local gird1ZMax = grid2Z * MapHelper.gridSize_2
    local gird1ZMin = (grid2Z - 1) * MapHelper.gridSize_2 + 1
    local spawnGrid1X = math.random(gird1XMin,gird1XMax)
    local spawnGrid1Z = math.random(gird1ZMin,gird1ZMax)
    return spawnGrid1X,spawnGrid1Z

        size = Vector2.new(tonumber(sizeStr[1]),tonumber(sizeStr[2]))
        _resPointSizeMap[prefab] = size
    end

    return size
end

function MapHelper:CreateBuilding(spawnGrid1X:number,spawnGrid1Z:number,sizeX:number,sizeZ:number,gridType:number,landmarkPrefab:Model,groundName:string?)
        local groundPosY = nil
        for offsetX = 1, sizeX do
            for offsetZ = 1, sizeZ do
                local grid1X = spawnGrid1X + offsetX - 1
                local grid1Z = spawnGrid1Z + offsetZ - 1
                -- print(grid1X, grid1Z)
                local ground = MapHelper:FindGroundPart(grid1X,grid1Z)
                if groundName and ground then
                    if not groundPosY then
                        groundPosY = ground.Position.Y
                    end

                    local newGround = MapHelper:CreateNormalLand(grid1X,grid1Z,groundPosY,groundName)
                    -- 复制Tag
                    local tags = ground:GetTags()
                    for _,tag in ipairs(tags) do
                        newGround:AddTag(tag)
                    end
                    ground:Destroy()
                    ground = newGround
                end
                if not ground then
                    ground = MapHelper:CreateNormalLand(grid1X,grid1Z,groundPosY,groundName)
                end
                if groundPosY then
                    local cframe = ground:GetPivot()
                    ground:PivotTo(cframe.Rotation + Vector3.new(cframe.Position.X,groundPosY,cframe.Position.Z))
                else
                    groundPosY = ground.Position.Y
                end

                MapHelper:SetMapGridType(grid1X,grid1Z,gridType or MapHelper.GridType.building)
            end
        end

        local posX,posZ = MapHelper:GetGridPos(spawnGrid1X,spawnGrid1Z)
        posX += sizeX / 2 * MapHelper.gridSize_1 - MapHelper.halfGridSize_1
        posZ += sizeZ / 2 * MapHelper.gridSize_1 - MapHelper.halfGridSize_1
        local ground:Part = MapHelper:FindGroundPart(spawnGrid1X,spawnGrid1Z)
        local posY = ground.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2
        local position = Vector3.new(posX,posY,posZ)
        local rotationY:number
        if sizeX == sizeZ then
            -- 360度随机旋转
            -- building:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position,position + Vector3.new(math.random(-1,1),0,math.random(-1,1))))
            -- rotationY = math.random() * 360
            -- 90度随机旋转
            rotationY = math.random(0,3) * 90
        else
            -- 只接受180度旋转
            rotationY = math.random(1,2) == 1 and 0 or 180
            if sizeZ > sizeX then
                rotationY += 90
            end
        end
        local landmark = landmarkPrefab:Clone()
        landmark:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position) * CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(rotationY),0))
        landmark.Parent = MapHelper:GetMapParent()

        return landmark
end

function MapHelper:CreateBuildingOnCenter(spawnGrid1X:number,spawnGrid1Z:number,sizeX:number,sizeZ:number,gridType:number,landmarkPrefab:Model,groundName:string?)
    local groundPosY = nil
    local minPos = MapHelper:GetGridPos3(spawnGrid1X,spawnGrid1Z)
    local maxPos = minPos
    for offsetX = 1, sizeX do
        for offsetZ = 1, sizeZ do
            local grid1X = spawnGrid1X + offsetX - math.ceil(sizeX / 2)
            local grid1Z = spawnGrid1Z + offsetZ - math.ceil(sizeZ / 2)
            -- print(grid1X, grid1Z)
            local ground = MapHelper:FindGroundPart(grid1X,grid1Z)
            if groundName and ground then
                if not groundPosY then
                    groundPosY = ground.Position.Y
                end

                local newGround = MapHelper:CreateNormalLand(grid1X,grid1Z,groundPosY,groundName)
                -- 复制Tag
                local tags = ground:GetTags()
                for _,tag in ipairs(tags) do
                    newGround:AddTag(tag)
                end
                ground:Destroy()
                ground = newGround
            end
            if not ground then
                ground = MapHelper:CreateNormalLand(grid1X,grid1Z,groundPosY,groundName)
            end
            if groundPosY then
                local cframe = ground:GetPivot()
                ground:PivotTo(cframe.Rotation + Vector3.new(cframe.Position.X,groundPosY,cframe.Position.Z))
            else
                groundPosY = ground.Position.Y
            end

            local tempPos = MapHelper:GetGridPos3(grid1X,grid1Z)
            minPos = Vector3.min(minPos,tempPos)
            maxPos = Vector3.max(maxPos,tempPos)

            MapHelper:SetMapGridType(grid1X,grid1Z,gridType or MapHelper.GridType.building)
        end
    end

    -- local posX,posZ = MapHelper:GetGridPos(spawnGrid1X,spawnGrid1Z)
    local posX = minPos.X + (maxPos.X - minPos.X) / 2
    local posZ = minPos.Z + (maxPos.Z - minPos.Z) / 2
    local ground:Part = MapHelper:FindGroundPart(spawnGrid1X,spawnGrid1Z)
    local posY = ground.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2
    local position = Vector3.new(posX,posY,posZ)
    local rotationY:number
    if sizeX == sizeZ then
        -- 360度随机旋转
        -- building:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position,position + Vector3.new(math.random(-1,1),0,math.random(-1,1))))
        -- rotationY = math.random() * 360
        -- 90度随机旋转
        rotationY = math.random(0,3) * 90
    else
        -- 只接受180度旋转
        rotationY = math.random(1,2) == 1 and 0 or 180
        if sizeZ > sizeX then
            rotationY += 90
        end
    end
    local landmark = landmarkPrefab:Clone()
    landmark:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position) * CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(rotationY),0))
    landmark.Parent = MapHelper:GetMapParent()

    return landmark
end

function MapHelper:initBuilding(building:BasePart,grid2X:number,grid2Z:number)
    if not building then return end
    ValueHelper:InitByModel(building,BuildingValue)
    ValueHelper:SetValue(building,BuildingValue.grid2,Vector3.new(grid2X,0,grid2Z))
    ValueHelper:SetValue(building,BuildingValue.level,MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid2Pos(grid2X,grid2Z))
    building:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Building)
end

function MapHelper:CreateNormalLand(grid1X:number,grid1Z:number,posY:number,prefabName:string?)
    if not prefabName then
        -- prefabName = string.format("%d级地块",zoneLv)
        prefabName = "Grassland"
    end
    local groundFolder = workspace:WaitForChild("Prefabs"):WaitForChild("Map"):WaitForChild("地块")
    local groundPrefab = groundFolder:FindFirstChild(prefabName)
    if not groundPrefab then
        groundPrefab = groundFolder:FindFirstChild("Grassland")
    end
    local ground:Part = groundPrefab:Clone()
    local posX,posZ = MapHelper:GetGridPos(grid1X,grid1Z)
    -- if MapHelper:FindGroundPart(grid1X,grid1Z) then
    --     error("重复创建了")
    -- end

    ValueHelper:InitByModel(ground,GroundValue)
    ValueHelper:SetValue(ground,GroundValue.grid,Vector3.new(grid1X,0,grid1Z))

    ground.Name = string.format("%d,%d",grid1X,grid1Z)
    -- ground.Size = Vector3.new(MapHelper.gridSize_1,ground.Size.Y,MapHelper.gridSize_1)
    ground:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(math.random(0,3) * 90),0) + Vector3.new(posX,posY or 0,posZ))
    ground.CollisionGroup = GameEnum.CollisionGroup.Ground
    ground:AddTag(GameEnum.Tag.Ground)
    
    ground.Parent = MapHelper:GetMapParent()

    local surface:SurfaceGui = ground:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SurfaceGui",true)
    if surface then
        if RunService:IsStudio() and MapHelper.GridInfoEnable then
            surface.Enabled = true
            -- local grid2X = math.ceil(grid1X / MapHelper.gridSize_2)
            -- local grid2Z = math.ceil(grid1Z / MapHelper.gridSize_2)
            local grid2X,grid2Z = MapHelper:Grid1ToGrid2(grid1X,grid1Z)
            -- local c1 = grid2X / MapHelper.gridSize_2
            -- local c2 = grid2Z / MapHelper.gridSize_2
            -- ground.Color = Color3.new(c1,c2,(c1+c2)/(MapHelper.gridSize_2*2))

            local t_index:TextLabel = surface:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel")
            if t_index then
                t_index.Text = string.format("%s\nlv:%d",ground.Name,MapHelper:GetZoneLevelByGrid2Pos(grid2X,grid2Z))
            end
        else
            surface.Enabled = false
        end
    end

    return ground
end

function MapHelper:RandomBuildingSize(sizeX:number,sizeZ:number)
    if sizeX ~= sizeZ and math.random(1,2) == 1 then
        local oldZ = sizeZ
        sizeZ = sizeX
        sizeX = oldZ
    end
    return sizeX,sizeZ
end

function MapHelper:IsInMapGrid1(grid1X:number,grid1Z:number)
    if grid1X < 1 or grid1X > MapHelper.mapSize_1 then
        return false
    end
    if grid1Z < 1 or grid1Z > MapHelper.mapSize_1 then
        return false
    end
    return true
end

function MapHelper:GetIsSafetyBuildingPoint(spawnGrid1X:number,spawnGrid1Z:number,sizeX:number,sizeZ:number,safeGridType:number?)
    if not safeGridType then
        safeGridType = MapHelper.GridType.land
    end

    for offsetX = 1, sizeX do
        for offsetZ = 1, sizeZ do
            local grid1X = spawnGrid1X + offsetX - 1
            local grid1Z = spawnGrid1Z + offsetZ - 1
            local tempGridType = MapHelper:GetMapGridType(grid1X,grid1Z)
            if tempGridType and tempGridType ~= safeGridType then
                return false
            end
        end
    end
    return true
end

local raycastGroundDir = Vector3.new(0,-100,0)
function MapHelper:RaycastGroundFromPart(part:BasePart,tag:string)
    local grounds = CollectionService:GetTagged(tag)
    if #grounds == 0 then return end

    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    raycastParams:AddToFilter(grounds)
    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include

    local hitResult:RaycastResult = workspace:Raycast(part.Position,raycastGroundDir,raycastParams)
    return hitResult
end

function MapHelper:SpawnSnow(ground:Part)
    -- 随机雪块
    local posX = ground.Position.X
    local posZ = ground.Position.Z
    local groundY = ground.Position.Y + ground.Size.Y / 2
    local num = math.random(1,3)
    local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Prefabs"):FindFirstChild("Map"):FindFirstChild("雪块")
    for i=1,num do
        local childs = folder:GetChildren()
        local snowX = math.random(posX-MapHelper.halfGridSize_1,posX + MapHelper.halfGridSize_1)
        local snowZ = math.random(posZ-MapHelper.halfGridSize_1,posZ + MapHelper.halfGridSize_1)
        -- local rotationY = math.random() * 360
        local rotationY = math.random(0,3) * 90
        local prefab:Model = childs[math.random(1,#childs)]
        local snow = prefab:Clone()
        snow:PivotTo(CFrame.Angles(0,math.rad(rotationY),0)+Vector3.new(snowX,groundY,snowZ))
        -- stone:PivotTo(prefab:GetPivot().Rotation + Vector3.new(stoneX,groundY,stoneZ))
        snow.Parent = workspace
    end
end

function MapHelper:GetBuildingEnterPlayerKey(Player:Player)
    return string.format("EnterBuildingPlayer_%d",Player.UserId)
end

function MapHelper:GetBuildingActivity(building:Model)
    if not building then return false end

    for _,player:Player in ipairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if building:HasTag(MapHelper:GetBuildingEnterPlayerKey(player)) then
            return true
        end
    end

    return false
end
